name: Process Load Versus Waste
applicable_contexts: support systems and process loads both plausible
utility intensity visible before throughput normalization is bounded
trigger_conditions: process line or throughput map unresolved
utility burden visible but dominant variable unclear
anti_triggers: process load is already normalized and bounded
physical_basis: Manufacturing energy can be structurally tied to throughput, temperature duty, process chemistry or material transformation rather than generic waste.
operational_basis: Without a process map and throughput context, teams can misclassify structural process load as avoidable waste.
financial_mechanism: Capital can be allocated against the wrong variable if structural production duty is mistaken for generic efficiency loss.
typical_false_assumption: High plant energy intensity automatically means waste.
hypothesis: Energy may be structural to production rather than waste, so the process-versus-support-system boundary must be discriminated first.
rival_hypotheses: throughput-normalized process load is already bounded
maintenance or tariff effects dominate before process logic does
evidence_required: major process thermal and motor loads
minimum_evidence_to_confirm: process duty explains a material share of the observed load
throughput-normalized context changes the framing materially
falsification_conditions: process duty is already normalized and bounded
process load is immaterial to the visible burden
allowed_claim_language: Energy may be structural to production rather than waste, so the process-versus-support-system boundary should be discriminated first.
financial_exposure_if_false: support-system waste framing may become more admissible
stop_conditions: process-versus-support-system boundary is bounded enough to rank the dominant driver
escalation_conditions: operations confirmation required if public evidence cannot discriminate throughput duty
claim_permissions_impact: block waste diagnosis before process normalization
example_outputs: Energy may be structural to production, not waste.
tests: manufacturing acceptance bundle should activate this when process load remains unresolved
pattern must stay bounded at L2
